quotes.author: Nick Erny
quotes.text: I’ve fished with Noah now for 4 years totaling somewhere around 12 days. Some days solo, some with friends. Let me tell you this guy doesn’t disappoint. Extremely knowledgeable on the area and the local fishery. Listens to his clients wants and desires and pulls through. He is dedicated, ambitious, and the best guide I’ve had the pleasure of fishing with. He communicates well before, during, and after the trip. Even having given me some advise for fishing out of the country. I plan to be back on his boat quite as long as its running. If you’ve even thought about have the adrenaline rush of you life sight fishing tarpon, snook, reds, big jacks, etc. then give Noah a call.

quotes.author: nicholas sheffield
quotes.text: Had an incredible full-day saltwater fly fishing trip with Captain Noah! Within the first 15 minutes, I landed my very first tarpon on the fly, and the action just kept going. We hooked and caught multiple tarpon throughout the day, making it a trip I’ll never forget. Noah was extremely patient, knowledgeable, and always willing to help. As an added bonus, he spent time improving my casting, which made me a better fly angler by the end of the day. If you’re looking for a top-notch fly fishing guide in Florida, I highly recommend booking a trip with Captain Noah. I’m already looking forward to next tarpon season and will definitely be fishing with him again!

quotes.author: Sharpeta J.
quotes.text: I booked this trip with low expectations as other guides have left me disappointed. But man was I wrong, Capt. Noah came ready to find us fish! He knew just where to go and when to leave. Overall, an incredible trip we had so much fun not only fishing but laughing with Capt. Noah we will remember this trip for years! The only guide on the treasure coast I recommend now.

quotes.author: Zach S
quotes.text: Noah is a fantastic guide who knows his stuff. Super knowledgeable and an all around great guy! If you want to catch some fish on fly, Noah will make it happen. Thanks again Noah for an awesome day!

quotes.author: scott
quotes.text: almost hate to write this review and keep it a secret but the man is to deserving. No fancy boat or electronics just skills!

quotes.author: Phil Tanner
quotes.text: Fantastic day of fishing, even with less than perfect weather Noah put us on fish. I highly recommend Noah.
